title: User prompts render after assistant responses (A-A-A-Q-Q-Q)
Status line shows a synthesized model name instead of Maki's real model
GET /api/event sends nothing during an idle gap, so the TUI auto-reconnects and re-boots, dropping the composer's next submit (permission turn never posts)
GET /api/fs/list lists the host directory the client names in location[directory] (and any absolute `path`) instead of the sandbox workdir: the bridge reads a host path on the client's behalf

Boot list routes answer synthesized `sample` rows the TUI renders as real: a connected MCP server, MCP resources, a running shell, an active server plugin, a reference alias, a server command whose pick POSTs session.command, and a `sample` agent with a `sample` permission rule
GET /api/info omits capabilities.persistentPty, so the TUI offers /terminal and the Terminals tab although the bridge serves no persistent PTY, and reports pid 0 and a non-URL `urls: ["sample"]`
An immediately-started prompt is never delivered, so the TUI renders its user message after the assistant reply (A-Q-Q-A order)

permission.asked names the action `allow` and the resource as the tool name, so the TUI permission dialog renders a generic `⚙ Call tool allow` / `Tool: allow` body instead of the shell command (`$ rm -f probe.txt`) the reference shows

session.tool.called, session.tool.success and session.tool.failed omit the required `executed` boolean (session-event.ts v2.0.32), so the TUI cannot apply a failed tool and its running spinner never settles on the live run

examples/policies/maki-minimal.yaml omits /dev/null, so with no provider attached every Maki bash call fails to spawn (`stdin(Stdio::null())`, maki-lua fn.rs v0.6.4 L299) with `Permission denied (os error 13)`
